programs.title: Brahms: The Boy II
programs.desc: Unaware of the terrifying history of Heelshire Mansion, a couple moves into the guest house where their son makes an unsettling new friend, a doll named Brahms.

programs.title: Chaos Walking
programs.desc: A girl crash-lands on a planet populated only by men and where everyone's thoughts are on display. To protect her, a man must discover his inner power and the place's secrets.

programs.title: London Fields
programs.desc: Femme fatale, Nicola Six is having a tangled love affair with three uniquely different men. She knows one of them will murder her on her birthday… but which one will it be?

programs.title: A Simple Favor
programs.desc: Stephanie, a mommy vlogger, seeks to uncover the truth behind her best friend Emily's sudden disappearance, all while fulfilling the simple favor Emily asked of her. Stephanie is joined on her quest by Emily's husband Sean, but shocking discoveries await them.

programs.title: Countdown
programs.desc: When an app claiming to predict a person’s death date gives her three days to live, a young nurse must find a way to save her life before time runs out.

programs.title: Above Suspicion
programs.desc: A newly married FBI agent becomes involved with his informant, setting them both on a collision course with deadly consequences.

programs.title: My Son
programs.desc: When a 7-year-old boy goes missing, his father, who’s been absent from his life since splitting with his wife, intends to do whatever it takes to find him.
